explanation: Docs keep decisions, invariants, provenance and procedure order and point to code for exact shapes, names and values (docs/README.md). CONTEXT.md entries name the owning file and its invariants; the trimmed form carries the router's navigation-attempt rules and a Route landing entry. PRODUCT, DESIGN, CHANGELOG, runbooks and dated records are as triaged, and PROJECT_GUIDANCE.md gains the files-not-in-this-repository section. evaluation.md names the CI steps that run the context suite.
